Symbols.Name: Boolean

Doc.Summary: Replaces the shapes with one path that is the result of the operation. The operands are rectangles, ellipses and closed paths that are visible and not locked (a group, an open path or a hidden or locked shape makes the operation PressToShape.Core.Documents.PathOperationFailure.Invalid), at least two. They are combined from the lowest in the document upward (see PressToShape.Core.PathOperations.BooleanEngine.Compute). The result sits where the lowest operand was (same layer and group, same place in the stack) and takes its fill, stroke, opacity, name and flags. It has no rotation and the even-odd fill rule, so holes show. If nothing is left the failure is PressToShape.Core.Documents.PathOperationFailure.Empty.

Params.cancellationToken: Checked while the result is computed.

Exceptions.Description: The token was cancelled.

A path with one sub-path, another type of shape, or a hidden or locked path is PressToShape.Core.Documents.PathOperationFailure.Invalid.

Params.newId: Makes the id of each new path.

Doc.Summary: The one place that walks nested shapes. All results are new values, the input is never changed. A group's box follows its children by itself (see PressToShape.Core.Shapes.GroupShape), so every method that changes children also updates the boxes of all ancestors.
